title: 第214章 魔焰金刚清明菩萨第213章 乱战之下岂有完卵
content_zh:
“找到你们，小老鼠们，你们跑不掉的。”金刚佛子骤然出现，随着他出现，身后跟着出现了一群弟子，密密麻麻包围了周围，这群弟子盯着眼前的三尊身影，金刚佛子指着前面的枯土尊者。
“枯土尊者，你们跑不掉，你们可真是让本佛子找得好辛苦。”
“这些日子，你们一直猎杀我佛门弟子，这笔账，我们该好好算一算。”
金刚佛子怒气冲冲，他是真的生气，也是真的很想要动手杀人，可他压抑住了，布局了这么久，终于等到了这群小老鼠出现，岂能让他们跑了？
这群小老鼠必须要杀死，然后找到黑莲的本体，杀光他们。
枯土尊者往前走一步，对着金刚佛子等人行了一个佛礼：“我佛慈悲，金刚佛子，我等是为了清理佛门污垢，佛门污垢太多了，需要以雷霆手段清理，方能够还佛门一个清净。”
“而你，金刚佛子，还有诸位师兄弟，你们应该和我们一起，为了创造更好的佛门而努力，而不是反对我们，也不是反抗我们。”
“诸位，加入我们，和我们一起奋斗，一起创造全新的佛门。”
伸手，邀请他们这些人，枯土尊者说话的声音带着某种特殊的磁性，仿佛是某种靡靡之音，诱惑眼前的这些弟子，黑气从地下开始蔓延，然后一步步靠近这些人，依靠话语是无法说服他们这些人的，还需要其他的手段。
哭木尊者非常清楚这一点，所以，他想要利用言语刺激这些人的心灵，然后再用黑气勾起他们的欲望，让他们沦为了黑气的傀儡，从而让这些人内讧，叛变金刚佛子，成为他们的一份子。
黑气，可以引起内心欲望，让他们被欲望掌控。
接下来，需要等待就行，等待他们……叛变就行。
这些人，不足为虑，最令人头痛的是金刚佛子，此子，威胁最大。
“哼，枯土尊者，收起来你的那点小手段，给我束手就擒，不要试图反抗。”
“尔等所犯下的罪孽不可饶恕，本佛子代替佛门惩罚你们。”
“尔等需要赎罪，必须以死谢罪，才能够清洗尔等身上的罪孽，枯土尊者，请你自裁，荣登极乐世界。”
金刚佛子冷冷扫过这些人，全部都要自裁，懒得他动手，在他眼里，这群人并不强，随手都可以拿捏，也都可以杀死他们。
一群被遗弃的边角料而已，竟敢做出这种事情，竟敢背叛佛门，不可原谅，不可饶恕。
金刚佛子十分愤怒，找了这么久，想不到是这三人搞出来的事情，他能不生气吗？还以为背后的敌人很强呢，黑莲就这点能耐，只能够掌控这些没用的小老鼠，不会以为依靠这几个人就可以推翻佛门吧？
“金刚佛子，息怒，何必如此动怒呢？”

“我们之间，可都是同门，你何必如此对付我等？”
“我佛慈悲，原谅尔等的冲撞，现如今，我佛给你们一个改过自新的机会，重新选择，投入我们，成为我们的一份子，好过尔等继续作恶。”
枯土尊者伸手，邀请金刚佛子身后的那群弟子，那些弟子可都是非常好的人选，若是策反了他们，对他们而言，有着巨大的好处，想要突破此地的束缚，也需要这群弟子帮忙。
不然，依靠他们三个人，是无法挣脱束缚的。
这一次，他们三个中招了，被对方坑害了。
枯土尊者丝毫不着急，身后的魔焰金刚和幽尘行者也不着急，他们不断扩散黑气，从地下开始蔓延过去，黑气到了那群弟子脚下，然后迅速扩散，这一步动作，十分隐秘。
content_en:
"I found you, little mice, you can't run away." Vajra Buddha suddenly appeared, and as he appeared, a group of disciples appeared behind him, densely surrounding the surroundings. This group of disciples stared at the three figures in front of them, and Vajra Buddha pointed at Lord Kutu in front.
"Venerable Kutu, you can't run away. You are really making it difficult for me to find you."
"These days, you have been hunting down my Buddhist disciples. We should settle this account carefully."
Vajra Buddha was furious. He was really angry, and he really wanted to kill someone, but he suppressed it. After planning for so long, he finally waited until these little mice appeared. How could he let them run away?
These little mice must be killed, and then find the true body of Black Lotus and kill them all.
Venerable Kutu took a step forward and performed a Buddhist salute to Vajra Buddha and others: "My Buddha is compassionate, Vajra Buddha, and we are here to clean up the dirt on Buddhism. There is too much dirt on Buddhism, and we need to use thunder to clean it up before we can restore Buddhism's purity."
"And you, Vajra Buddha, and all the other brothers and sisters, you should work with us to create a better Buddhism, instead of opposing us or resisting us."
"Everyone, join us, fight with us, and create a new Buddhism together."
Reaching out to invite them, Lord Kutu spoke with a special magnetism, as if it was some kind of overwhelming sound, seducing the disciples in front of him. The black energy began to spread from the ground, and then approached these people step by step. It was impossible to convince these people with words, and other means were needed.
Lord Weeping Wood knows this very well, so he wants to use words to stimulate the hearts of these people, and then use black energy to arouse their desires, making them become the puppets of black energy, so that these people can fight among themselves, rebel against Vajra Buddha, and become one of them.
Black energy can arouse inner desires and allow them to be controlled by desires.
Next, just wait, wait for them... to rebel.
These people are nothing to worry about. The most troublesome one is Vajra Buddha. This person is the greatest threat.
"Hmph, Lord Kutu, put away your little tricks and let me catch you without any help. Don't try to resist."
"The sins you have committed are unforgivable, and I, the Buddha, will punish you on behalf of Buddhism."
"You need to atone for your sins. You must die to apologize for your sins, so that the sins on your body can be washed away. Lord Kutu, please commit suicide and ascend to the Paradise of Elysium."
Vajra Buddha glanced at these people coldly, all of them wanted to commit suicide, and he was too lazy to take action. In his eyes, these people were not strong, and they could be manipulated and killed at will.
A group of abandoned scraps, how dare to do such a thing, how dare to betray Buddhism, unforgivable, unforgivable.
Vajra Buddha was very angry. After searching for so long, he didn't expect that these three people were responsible for this. How could he not be angry? I thought the enemy behind him was very strong. Heilian was only capable of controlling these useless little mice. He didn't think he could overthrow Buddhism by relying on these few people, right?
"Vajra Buddha, calm down, why are you so angry?"
"We are all from the same sect, why do you treat me like this?"
"I am merciful and forgive you for your conflict. Now, I am giving you a chance to change your ways, make a new choice, join us, and become one of us. It is better than you continuing to do evil."
Lord Kutu stretched out his hand and invited the group of disciples behind Vajra Buddha. Those disciples were all very good candidates. If they were to instigate rebellion, it would be of huge benefit to them. If they wanted to break through the shackles of this place, they would also need the help of this group of disciples.
Otherwise, relying on the three of them, it would be impossible to break free.
This time, the three of them fell into the trap and were tricked by each other.
Lord Kutu was not in any hurry. The Demon Flame King Kong and the Ghost Walker behind himNot in a hurry, they continued to spread the black energy, starting from the underground. The black energy reached the feet of the disciples, and then spread quickly. This move was very secretive.
